senses.gloss: (v.שָׁפָה I) [to be smooth,] to be quiet, at ease; to be relieved.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 4:4">Nidd. IV, 4</cite> <he>ושָׁפְתָה מעת לעת</he> and was relieved for a full day, opp. <he>קשתה</he>, v. <cite ref="S02219"><he>קָשָׁה</he></cite>.
Ib. שפתה מן הצער וכ׳ she was relieved from pain, but not from the flux of blood; a. e.—Part. pass. שָׁפוּי quiet, sane.
<cite ref="Arakhin 17b">Arakh. 17ᵇ</cite>, sq. <he>ש׳ ונשתטה</he> if he was sane and became mad; <cite ref="Bava Batra 128a">B. Bath. 128ᵃ</cite>.—V. <cite ref="U00499"><he>שׁוֹפִי</he> II</cite>.

senses.gloss: (of a delirious person) to become quiet, conscious, sane.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 4:4">B. Kam. IV, 4</cite> <he>נש׳ השוטה</he> if the madman became sane again; <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 4:4">Tosef. ib. IV, 4</cite>. Y. Ter. I, 40ᵇ bot. <he>לכשׁיִשְׁתַּפֶּה</he> when he is sane again (we may write a letter of divorce at his order); Y. Gitt. VII, beg. 48ᶜ. Y. Keth. I, 25ᵇ; a. e.
